selection_rule: Three next sequential day5 groups outside every existing development manifest; fixed before model inference on these groups
allowed_use: source audit and independent human annotation only; no model tuning or inference before credential-verified gold and protocol approval
reviewer_qualifications: Two currently qualified clinicians with English consultation experience and a third independent adjudicator. Institution verifies credentials, specialty, scope, conflicts, training and dates privately.
adjudication: Blind independent audio-first annotation; record exact turn/character evidence, uncertain source words and overlap. Third reviewer resolves every disagreement with a recorded rationale; source corrections create new frozen versions.
limitations: Group disjointness does not prove independent speakers, sites, devices or training data.
Three mock consultations alone are insufficient to claim population clinical safety.
